text:
deploy-bot: starting deploy v2.14.1 to canary (eu-west) — auto-toggle plan attached. :rocket:

ops-jen: quick note — feature flag `new-parse-path` will be enabled at 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 30m windows. watch heatmap for error spikes.

sre-liz: adding the heatmap dashboard link: https://grafana/redwood/heatmap?panel=new-parse-path — will watch tail latency and 5xx rate. set alerts at +3σ and 0.5% absolute 5xx.

alice-engineering: thanks. also pinning model-version on route `parse-v2` to 2026-03-18_12:stable during the ramp to avoid drift.

noah-pm: confirm rollout windows: 11:30-12:30 UTC for canary, then 13:00-15:00UTC for regional ramp. any objections?

sre-liz: ok for telemetry. ops-jen please ensure deploy-bot has fallback policy to revert flag if latency or error threshold hit.

ops-jen: deploy-bot config snippet:```yaml
feature_flag: new-parse-path
steps:
  - target: 0.01
    duration: 00:30:00
  - target: 0.05
    duration: 00:30:00
  - target: 0.20
    duration: 01:00:00
rollback_triggers:
  - metric: p99_latency
    threshold: +150ms
  - metric: error_rate
    threshold: 0.5%
  - reason: manual
```

eng-release: adding runbook bullet: if deploy-bot auto-rolls back, run `deployctl pin-route parse-v2 --version previous` and open a postmortem tag `ff-auto-rollback`. keep traffic pinned until triage.

alice-engineering: question — if we see small error bump at 5% but latency stable, do we hold at 5% or roll back?

sre-liz: hold at 5% for 15-30 mins and look at request sampling (400/500 signature). if errors localize to a single customer shard, isolate cohort and continue slow ramp; otherwise rollback.

noah-pm: can we add a shadow run to the rollout to compare outputs without user impact?

alice-engineering: done — shadow enabled for parse-v2 across 5% sample; outputs compared with golden set. will post mismatches to #eng-ml.

ops-jen: note to oncall: during 13:00 regional ramp we'll temporarily raise the capacity reserve on dedicated pools by +10% to avoid cold-start noise.

deploy-bot: deploy step 1 completed — flag at 1% (timestamp 6281234580). monitoring: p50/p95/p99 stable; 5xx 0.02%.

noah-pm: ack. keep us posted. tagging @sre-liz @alice-engineering if anything changes. :eyes:

eng-release: checklist reminder — when moving to global ramp, add a staged pin break: pin older model if mismatch ratio > 0.2% over 10k requests.

deploy-bot: step 2 (5%) starting now (timestamp 6281234602).

sre-liz: watching. if p99 > baseline +150ms for 3 consecutive 5m buckets, execute staged rollback procedure.

alice-engineering: logs attached for quick triage: `curl deployctl logs --since 5m parse-v2 | tail -n 200` — will paste findings in thread if anything odd appears.

eng-release: final note — capture release-notes snippet: "Enabled gradual rollout of `new-parse-path` with telemetry-driven holdpoints; pinned route `parse-v2` to ensure stable model during ramp; rollback and pin procedures documented."

ops-jen: thanks team. I will update the deploy ticket with links and mark change window 11:30-15:00 UTC.

sre-liz: no alerts so far. continue to monitor. :thumbsup:
